description: Manage Flagsmith feature flags, environments, segments and tags, turn flags on or off and change their values, read the audit log, and follow new flags, flag changes and audit log entries.

flagsmith_flag_changed_trigger.description: Runs when a flag is turned on or off, or its value or targeting changes, in the environment.

output.flag: The record returned by the service

flagsmith_new_audit_log_entry_trigger.description: Runs for each new entry in the audit log: a flag, segment, environment or setting changed.

output.entry: The record returned by the service

parameters.description: Only changes in this project. Leave empty for every project.
parameters.name: project_id

flagsmith_new_environment_trigger.description: Runs when an environment is added to the project.

output.environment: The record returned by the service

flagsmith_new_feature_trigger.description: Runs when a feature flag is created in the project.

output.feature: The record returned by the service

flagsmith_new_segment_trigger.description: Runs when a segment is created in the project.

output.segment: The record returned by the service
